bibl.title: Il primo episodio dell'"Ipsipile" di Euripide.
bibl.seg: Chiara Lampugnani, Il primo episodio dell'"Ipsipile" di Euripide.
Frammenti sulla scena (online). Studi sul dramma antico frammentario 0 (2019) pp. 101-123.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. VI, 852 (= MP3 438; LDAB 957). A new critical analysis induces to conserve the readings of the papyrus, which seem to point out the difficult situation of Amphiaraus: he is in an uninhabited place and needs Hypsipyle's help in finding spring-water to celebrate a sacrifice on behalf of the army on crossing the frontier.
